nodes.prompt: Investigate the supplied uncertainty for caller {{input.caller}} and issue {{input.issue}}. Start with the supplied evidence references {{input.evidenceRefs}}, then gather only the bounded additional evidence allowed by the factory-investigate skill. Return exactly one declared typed outcome: ready, needs_input, split, not_reproducible, needs_research, unknown, interrupted, or exhausted. Also return a structured result conforming to schemas/investigation-result.schema.json with caller, outcome, and stable evidenceRefs. Keep evidence references concise and never copy logs or secrets. Do not edit lifecycle labels or invoke Factory scripts.
